svg.text: FloodMesh V3 - 4x4 membrane keypad to Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3
8 wires, no resistors. Every keypad wire goes to header J3. Row order is reversed (keypad pin 1 goes to J3-10); columns run in order.
Heltec WiFi LoRa 32 V3 - header J3
count pins from the GND / 3V3 / 3V3 end of J3
never connect: J3-4 (37 battery sense), J3-5/6 (46/45 strapping), J3-14 (GPIO 3 strapping)
Check first: hold key 1 and measure keypad pin 1 to pin 5 in resistance mode (about 100 Ω pressed, open released).
